Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the conversation on Friday. We ran the internal tech review and Quantisys would like a short product demo focused on inference latency and cost optimizations for our production models, plus an executive intro so our VP of Engineering (Maya Lin) and CIO (Dan Cho) can see the strategic fit.

Ideal windows from our side next week:
- Tue 25 Jun, 16:00–16:45 PT
- Wed 26 Jun, 09:00–09:45 PT

Two asks for the session:
1) Please confirm if a Redwood VP or senior product sponsor can join for the first 15–20 minutes for a strategic overview.
2) We have a short security checklist to walk through after the demo (SOC2 evidence + data residency Qs). I attached a draft mutual action plan to this email for scope and owners.

Attachment: Quantisys-MutualActionPlan.xlsx (xlsx)

Would appreciate a quick confirmation on attendees and which window works.

Thanks,

Hi Elaine — thanks for the MAP and the proposed windows. Both look doable.

Quick answers:
- I can cover the strategic sponsor portion if you want a Redwood exec-level lens; alternatively Marissa (VP, Product) can join the top of the session for 15 minutes and then hand to Ben for the technical deep-dive.
- We can reserve Tue 25 Jun, 16:00–16:45 PT as primary and Wed 26 Jun, 09:00 PT as backup.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm coverage? Marissa, if you can do the sponsor intro, Ben will take the demo + Q&A on architecture and latency. If Marissa is out, I can step in.

Elaine — once we confirm attendees I will send a calendar invite and share a short demo brief (15 slides) and the credentials for a sandbox workload if you want to exercise inference traces live. Also we’ll have someone from Security available for the checklist follow-up — please flag any specific docs you need in advance.
